KeysToEntries.Oath1.Entry1: Treat other players with respect and will not harass or bully others.
KeysToEntries.Oath1.Entry2: Play fairly and not deceive or cheat other players.
KeysToEntries.Oath1.Entry3: Respect privacy and never share my own or others’ personal information.
KeysToEntries.Oath2.Entry1: Exploit the game in ways that negatively impact others.
KeysToEntries.Oath2.Entry2: Use language that could make others feel threatened or uncomfortable.
KeysToEntries.Oath.Title: The Adventurer Oaths
KeysToEntries.Oath3.Entry1: Offer help to other players whenever I can.
KeysToEntries.Oath3.Entry2: Use in-game tools to report inappropriate behaviour or content.
KeysToEntries.Oath2.Entry3: Engage in discussions involving illegal or harmful topics.
KeysToEntries.Oath2.Entry4: Deliberately disrupt or sabotage another player’s experience.
